contentCheck.notes: Crop shows the particle diagram of ions X and Y surrounded by water molecules, the full stem and choices A-D.

primary.evidence: Must use the orientation of water molecules around each ion (oxygen end toward a cation, hydrogen ends toward an anion) to decide the charge of X and Y.

supporting.evidence: Must compare the drawn sizes of X and Y with the relative radii of Na+, K+, Cl- and F- to choose between the remaining ion pairs.

contextual.evidence: The question is presented as a particulate diagram of a solution.

uncertainty: Unsure whether ion size is decisive or only orientation; atomic-radius kept as supporting.
